generator: Built-in image_gen tool; no CLI fallback
reference: Original CasMANGO idle and wave PNGs; pointing lab-coat variant used as the outfit reference for subsequent poses
common_constraints: Preserve CasMANGO identity: golden rounded-square head, cream face, dark brown outline and oval eyes, pink cheeks, twin green leaves, yellow-green DNA body, small golden hands and feet. All poses wear the same open white lab coat, with DNA visible. Cute polished shaded 2D style. One centered full-body mascot, transparent background, complete extremities, clear margin, no text or scenery.

pose_prompts.idle: Preserve the original standing neutral pose and gentle closed-mouth smile. Add the matching open white lab coat. Both arms relaxed, no props.
pose_prompts.wave: Preserve the original friendly waving pose and cheerful face. Add the matching lab coat. One raised waving hand, one relaxed hand. No floor shadow or other props.
pose_prompts.point: Friendly scientist guide in an open white lab coat, one hand extended toward the adjacent instructions, palm gently open, other arm relaxed, calm welcoming smile, no badges.
pose_prompts.flask: Thoughtful scientist in the same open white lab coat, holding one small Erlenmeyer flask containing teal liquid, looking attentively at it, other hand relaxed, soft friendly smile, no other equipment.
pose_prompts.inspect: Scientist in the matching lab coat, holding one small simple magnifying glass at chest level off to one side, curious gentle expression. Do not cover or distort the face; other hand relaxed.
pose_prompts.checklist: Scientist in the matching lab coat, holding a clipboard and simple pencil. Clipboard shows three small green checks and short horizontal strokes, no letters or numbers. Calm prepared friendly expression.
pose_prompts.success: Scientist in the matching lab coat giving one clear thumbs-up, warm happy smile, other hand relaxed. Restrained encouragement, no jumping, waving, speech bubble or confetti.

delivery: Transparent WebP, 360 x 432 pixels, quality 90 and alpha quality 100. Originals retained in the generated_images collection.
behavior: Stable poses by subject block. Success appears only for completed interactive actions or tour completion, with one 520 ms acknowledgement; no repeating movement. Reduced-motion preference disables that animation.
